title: Isi (sages whose father was named Isi)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites R' Hanina bar Isi — Terumot, chapter 4, halakhah 4; Rabbah bar Isi — Sotah 30a.[^1]

notes.text: The complete Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 4:4 section, eight paragraphs, was read without matching Hanina bar Isi. This is a bounded nonmatch, not absence elsewhere or a locator correction, so that pointer remains R' Hanina. Davidson Sotah 30a has Rabbah ben Isi, whereas the supplied pointer has bar Isi; both forms stay distinct. The grouping does not prove one father or a shared identity.
